mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_message(conversation_id, sender_id, receiver_id, msg_type, content, extra_json, status, check_status, create_time, visible_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, 0, 14, #{content}, NULL, 0, 1, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE im_message SET extra_json = #{extraJson} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE im_conversation SET last_msg_type = 14, last_msg_text = #{text}, last_msg_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{conversationId}
UPDATE im_conversation_member SET unread_count = unread_count + 1 WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND member_id != #{senderId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.sql: id, conversation_id AS conversationId, message_id AS messageId, creator_member_id AS creatorMemberId, title, max_slots AS maxSlots, active_count AS activeCount, status, deadline_at AS deadlineAt, version, (deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS pastDeadline
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_chain(conversation_id, message_id, creator_member_id, title, max_slots, active_count, status, deadline_at, version) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{creatorMemberId}, #{title}, #{maxSlots}, 0, 'OPEN', #{deadlineAt}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_chain WHERE id = #{id} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT MAX(id) FROM im_chain WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT FROM im_chain WHERE id = #{id} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE im_chain SET active_count = #{activeCount}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.sql: id, chain_id AS chainId, member_id AS memberId, content, position, status, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_chain_entry WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM im_chain_entry WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), 0) + 1 FROM im_chain_entry WHERE chain_id = #{chainId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_chain_entry(chain_id, member_id, content, position, status, request_id, version) VALUES (#{chainId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{position}, 'ACTIVE', #{requestId}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE im_chain_entry SET status = #{status}, content = #{content}, request_id = #{requestId}, version = version + 1 WHERE chain_id = #{chainId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_channel_checkin(channel_id, member_id, checkin_date, source, streak, request_id) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{memberId}, #{date}, 'CHANNEL', #{streak}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_channel_checkin WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND checkin_date > DATE_SUB(#{date}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND checkin_date <= #{date}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT member_id, COUNT(1) AS days FROM im_channel_checkin WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND checkin_date > DATE_SUB(#{date}, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND checkin_date <= #{date} GROUP BY member_id) t WHERE t.days > #{days} OR (t.days = #{days} AND t.member_id < #{memberId})
